description: The bar chart illustrates the F1 scores (%) of different models across four datasets—PSM, SWaT, SMAP, and MSL—comparing the performance of MADLLM against two variants: MADLLM w/o feature embedding and MADLLM w/o skip embedding. The vertical axis represents the F1 Score (%) on a linear scale ranging from 80 to 100, with tick marks at intervals of 10. The horizontal axis lists the datasets, with the bars grouped by dataset and colored according to the model: light green for MADLLM, purple for MADLLM w/o feature embedding, and orange for MADLLM w/o skip embedding. For the PSM dataset, MADLLM achieves the highest F1 score, approximately 98%, followed by MADLLM w/o feature embedding at around 95%, and MADLLM w/o skip embedding at about 92%. In the SWaT dataset, MADLLM again shows the highest score, approximately 92%, while MADLLM w/o feature embedding has the lowest score, around 86%, and MADLLM w/o skip embedding is slightly higher at about 87%. For the SMAP dataset, MADLLM scores approximately 94%, MADLLM w/o feature embedding is around 91%, and MADLLM w/o skip embedding is about 91%. In the MSL dataset, MADLLM achieves an F1 score of approximately 93%, MADLLM w/o feature embedding is around 90%, and MADLLM w/o skip embedding is about 89%. Overall, MADLLM consistently outperforms both variants across all datasets, with the largest performance gap observed in the SWaT dataset.
